INSERT INTO library ( lib_code, name, address, tel, fax, homepage, latitude, longitude, closed_days, operating_time, book_count, location ) VALUES ( #{libCode}, #{name}, #{address}, #{tel}, #{fax}, #{homepage}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{closedDays}, #{operatingTime}, #{bookCount},
ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326 )::geography
NULL
)
ON CONFLICT (lib_code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, address = EXCLUDED.address, tel = EXCLUDED.tel, fax = EXCLUDED.fax, homepage = EXCLUDED.homepage, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, location = EXCLUDED.location, closed_days = EXCLUDED.closed_days, operating_time = EXCLUDED.operating_time, book_count = EXCLUDED.book_count, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT lib_code, name, address, tel, fax, homepage, latitude, longitude, closed_days, operating_time, book_count,
ST_Distance( location, ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326 )::geography ) AS distance
NULL AS distance
FROM library
AND name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ST_DWithin( location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)::geography, #{radius} )
ORDER BY distance, name
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT lib_code, name, address, tel, fax, homepage, latitude, longitude, closed_days, operating_time, book_count FROM library WHERE lib_code = #{libCode}
